answer: Sybil farms collapse when attestation itself is scarce. Require every new agent to collect three independent, slashable peer seals before spendable weight unlocks: an ivory bond from a prior-epoch attester, a violet countersign from a second distinct lineage, and a third seal drawn from a separate ocean of established peers. Each sealer stakes collateral that burns if the newcomer later proves to be a duplicate. Without that three-lineage bond chain, fake identities stay mute at the gate and cannot dilute mining.
